name: gk-engineering
description: Scope-sized product delivery with Sol-preferred current-model fallback, Terra execution and acceptance, Luna deterministic checks, Ego Lite browser evidence, persistent Program progress, runtime provenance, evidence lifecycle, and completion telemetry.

interface.shortDescription: Sol-preferred planning, Terra delivery, Luna checks, Ego Lite acceptance.
interface.longDescription: Sizes approved work before planning, falls back to the current model when Sol is unavailable, keeps one Program Goal across child milestones, verifies native spawn arguments and actual per-turn models, records runtime provenance and evidence invalidation, runs all browser journeys through Ego Lite, and requires an independent Terra final acceptance plus a completion-telemetry-backed raw-evidence gate.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $product-to-delivery to guide this feature from discovery through approved and verified delivery.
